summary.text: Phil Segraves is the Republican candidate for Alabama House of Representatives District 17 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary runoff on June 16, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Phil Segraves previously ran for the seat in 2018, when Tracy Estes defeated him in the Republican primary runoff for Alabama House of Representatives District 17 on July 17, 2018.
